messages:
Maya: Starting thread to finalize cloud marketplace packaging for the upcoming GA listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need final SKU decisions, per-cloud artifact refs, and the short trial blurb. Goal: lock by EOD so ingestion can run tomorrow.
Jasper: Quick rundown: AWS needs AMI ids + pricing CSV, Azure wants SIG version ids, GCP can use container digest + productId. We'll keep a canonical CSV and a per-cloud mapping.
Rohan: AMI status: x86 AMIs replicated to us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1. IDs: ami-rl-x86-230326 (us-east-1), ami-rl-x86-230327 (us-west-2), ami-rl-x86-230328 (eu-west-1). arm64 currently only in us-east-1: ami-rl-arm-230326.
Maya: SKU naming suggestion: rwinf.<edition>.<units>.<region>. Example: rwinf.enterprise.1.us. Keep display_name short. Add columns: arch,gpu_profile,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_url.
Jasper: Sample CSV posted in checklist: ``sku,display_name,edition,units,region,arch,gpu_profile,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_url
rwinf.enterprise.1.us,Redwood Inference Enterprise - 1 unit,enterprise,1,us-east-1,x86_64,a100,USD,14,https://artifacts.redwood/skus/enterprise-1.json``
Legal: Trial/EULA snippet: "Try Redwood Inference free for up to 14 days. Cancel during the trial to avoid charges. By starting the trial you agree to automatic conversion to paid billing unless cancelled prior to trial end. Data processing governed by Redwood DPA v2: https://legal.redwood/dpa-v2." Attach DPA for EU SKUs.
Rohan: Azure SIG refs: rl-pro-gallery:version-4 (us + eu), GCP container: gcr.io/redwood/rl:2026-03-26@sha256:beefcafe. SBOM link: https://artifacts.redwood/sbom/rl-2026-03-26.json.
infra-bot: Marketplace lint: 3 warnings \u2014 (1) missing DPA_attachment for eu SKUs, (2) arm SKUs ambiguous region mapping, (3) price_currency missing on two SKUs. See /lint/1722223334-report.json
Maya: Action recap: Jasper = publish final per-cloud mapping (tomorrow AM), Rohan = add missing price_currency and attach DPA for eu SKUs (EOD), Legal = confirm EULA copy is fine for marketplaces (ASAP). I'll run a 10m gating call at 16:30 to triage lint. If you can't join, drop files in the checklist and tag me. :white_check_mark:
